# Vendored test vectors

Examples copied from IETF RFCs, which the tests check Gatekeep against. Each
file names its section in `source`. The values are unchanged; only the JSON
around them is ours.

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `rfc7515_a3_es256.json` | [RFC 7515](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7515) Appendix A.3 |
| `rfc7636_appendix_b.json` | [RFC 7636](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7636) Appendix B |
| `rfc7638_thumbprint.json` | [RFC 7638](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7638) Section 3.1 |
| `rfc9449_vectors.json` | [RFC 9449](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9449) Figures 2 and 13, Section 6.1 |
